item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem:
Meera watches the Moon from her balcony in Jaipur for a month. She notices that the bright part of the Moon looks different on different nights, changing from a thin crescent to a full circle and back again.

Which statement correctly explains what she sees?

options.A: The Moon's own shape changes as it moves around the Earth
options.B: The bright part of the Moon seen from Earth changes as sunlight falls on different parts of the Moon
options.C: The Moon makes its own light, and this light becomes stronger and weaker
options.D: Clouds and shadows cover the Moon, so its shape looks different
